home.meta: Alliance Dance in Montreal: dance classes, a performing company, studio rentals and artistic productions.

hero.title: More than dance. A way to create, connect & inspire.
hero.tagline: Rooted in Montreal. Driven by artistry. Connected through movement.
hero.intro: Alliance brings together dancers, artists and creative minds of all backgrounds and levels through education, performance, inspiring spaces and artistic productions. From first steps to international stages, we share a space where passion meets experience, creativity takes shape and everyone has room to grow.

cta.title: Every great story starts with a first move.
cta.body: Whether you're taking your first dance class, joining our artistic community or bringing a creative project to life, there's a place for you at Alliance.
